title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust is the first protocol that guarantees safe, transparent navigation in AI systems—no more black-box decisions.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential to measure trustworthiness objectively; without it, protocols like NavTrust are just theoretical.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust uses real-world datasets and formal verification to ensure reliability—benchmarks can't replicate that depth.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarks evolve with new threats; NavTrust could become obsolete if it doesn’t adapt to emerging risks.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Benchmarking provides the standard that protocols must meet—without it, trust is just a buzzword.
